role: Converts non-conventional MANURE into conventional H2O / C / H2 / O2 / N2 / S / ash / char (Fortran calculator)
Mixes decomposed manure with pressurised water into a slurry (≤20 wt% solids)
HTL product yield distribution (biocrude components and char) set by Fortran calculator
Secondary HTL reactions by Gibbs free-energy minimisation
Catalytic hydrothermal gasification of dissolved organics to CH4 / CO2 / NH3
Separates CHG off-gas from organic-free water
Adjusts aqueous feed to column inlet temperature
Fractional distillation of the aqueous phase
conditions: 6 theoretical stages, molar reflux ratio 1, bottoms 70,259.5 kg/h, feed COD 650 mg/L to <250 mg/L
